result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that renders mostly well, with only minor visual issues related to text truncation on horizontally-scrolling cards.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the right edge with truncated text, which is expected for a horizontal scroll but can look broken if there's no visual scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle gradient fade or partial peek that clearly signals horizontal scrolling, and ensure card names truncate cleanly with ellipsis.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icons appear inconsistent: the ramen card uses a white circle with dark outline heart, while the pizza card uses a dark circle with white heart, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background and color treatment across all restaurant cards for consistency.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is partially cut off by the viewport/navigation bar, showing only the top portion.
issues.suggestion: Ensure adequate bottom padding so partially visible cards don't appear awkwardly clipped against the fixed navigation bar.
